title: Checkpoint: symmetric grid
prompt:
A square grid is **symmetric** if `g[r][c] == g[c][r]` for every r, c. Implement `process(int[][] g)` returning true/false (a 1×1 grid is trivially symmetric).

Examples: `{{1,2},{2,1}}` → true, `{{1,2},{3,1}}` → false.

tests.name: symmetry check
tests.hint: Compare each pair once (c starts at r + 1); any mismatch returns false immediately.
